steps.title: Add your repo
steps.why: Sindri works on the code you point it at, so it needs at least one repository.

steps.title: Approve your profile
steps.why: Your profile says what Sindri may do on this machine, and nothing runs until you approve it.
steps.detail: Your profile is ready for you to read and approve.

steps.title: Approve the workflows
steps.why: Workflows are the step-by-step recipes Sindri follows, and each one needs your approval before it can run.

steps.title: Connect your coding agent
steps.why: Registering Sindri with your agent, for each repo only, lets the agent ask Sindri for context and report back.
steps.detail: Add your repo and approve your profile first.

steps.title: Map your code
steps.why: The map is how Sindri knows how your code, tickets and decisions connect, so what it tells an agent is relevant.
steps.detail: Sindri builds the map once your repo is added and your profile is approved.

steps.title: Set up Onyx
steps.why: Onyx is the search Sindri uses to find your business context, such as decisions and tickets.
